name: Sovereign Code Architect & Impact Planner
description: Parallel FIFO OKF knowledge-graph & repo survey followed by a 200-turn ReAct implementation planner that produces a verified implementation plan.

inputs.name: objective
inputs.label: Architecture Objective
inputs.placeholder: Describe the feature, subsystem refactor, or protocol change to plan...

phases.name: Phase 1: Parallel FIFO Knowledge Graph Survey
Phase 2: ReAct Architecture & Blast-Radius Plan
phases.prompt_template:
Draft a rigorous implementation plan for the following Blue Lodge architecture objective:

OBJECTIVE:
{{params.objective}}

PRE-FLIGHT FIFO SURVEY:
- OKF Graph Matches: {{phase.okf_survey.okf_matches}}
- Workspace Root: {{phase.okf_survey.workspace_root}}

EXECUTION STEPS:
1. Inspect affected files, symbols, and blast radius via file_read, file_grep, and code_outline.
2. Produce a concrete step-by-step plan covering affected files, security boundaries, FIFO IPC impact, and verification tests.
3. Write structured JSON to {{result_path}} with keys: workflow, objective, affected_files (array), steps (array), risks (array), verification_plan (array), and plan_markdown.
4. Call milestone_complete and summarize the architecture plan clearly.
